next.reason: 1985: 'The clauses SYNCHRONIZED, PICTURE, JUSTIFIED, and BLANK WHEN ZERO must not be specified except for an elementary data item.'; 2023: 'The PICTURE, JUSTIFIED, and BLANK WHEN ZERO clauses may be specified only for an elementary data item.'. 2023 keeps the elementary-only rule for PICTURE, JUSTIFIED and BLANK WHEN ZERO but drops SYNCHRONIZED. SYNCHRONIZED on a group item is no longer refused by this rule.
